suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 affects Kotlin Gradle plugin KAPT incremental-cache deserialization, not the JVM standard library. Its patch changes plugins/kapt/kapt-base cache.kt. The SDK uses Java/Maven and does not include KAPT or the Kotlin Gradle plugin. https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-r937-wjx7-w2jp https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin/commit/bf51df665b458fda7c3eaf436c4d88dc119d7ec6 https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-53914

The reviewed advisory and JetBrains bulletin identify kotlin-stdlib <=1.4.20 as affected by CVE-2020-29582, fixed in 1.4.21. Version 1.9.10 is outside that range. This does not endorse deprecated createTempDir calls; the SDK does not use that API. https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cqj8-47ch-rvvq https://blog.jetbrains.com/blog/2021/02/03/jetbrains-security-bulletin-q4-2020/
